notes: kb/Work PB885. 'Data-name-1 and data-name-2 shall not be subscripted': every OCCURS data-name operand (DEPENDING in formats 2 and 3, KEY) is captured through the ONE data-name-n screen ClauseDataName and a written subscript draws COBOL2024.
